### 2026-10-24 – I had an error where the proper kailh choc footprint wasn showing up for me to assign it to the sw_push and I searched up why it wouldn't work and it told me to check if the footprint library had been

**0.5h**

I had an error where the proper kailh choc footprint wasn showing up for me to assign it to the sw_push and I searched up why it wouldn't work and it told me to check if the footprint library had been even installed properly so I check and I thought it was but then it told me to check the tutorial and I did that and I couldn't find anything off and I was really frustrated so I asked gemini if something was wrong with my computer and it told me to input the tutorial and what I saw on the footrprint preferences and It told me I had put the wrong file in the preferred footprints and I check and I had originally accidentally put the whole main library instead of just the .pretty file which was my mistake, I shouldnt have done that, after I fixed that the kailh choc switch showed up in the footprint library and I was able to attach them to the proper sw_push parts. The first image was what I originally saw, the second image was the mistake of putting the wrong folder in, and the third image is the correct folder in and what I saw after fixing my mistake in the footprint library (choc switches showed up properly).

### 2026-10-25 – I finished making the custom keypad for the pcb but I ran into multiple priblems where I didnt scale it big enough so I had to redo it at least 4 times until I got it to the correct size and then I wi

**7h**

I finished making the custom keypad for the pcb but I ran into multiple priblems where I didnt scale it big enough so I had to redo it at least 4 times until I got it to the correct size and then I wired the pcb and made sure all the correct components were there and then I i got multiple problems in drc where the clearance was wrong and I aske gemini how to fix it and it kept giving me wrong answers and I accidentally deleted my keyboard and had to redo it again and then I switched to chatgpt and gpt told me that I could ignore those errors and at this point I was very frustrated because I had new errors pop up because I realized later that I had forgot t connect the keypad to the proper library so the footprint assigning was empty and I had to fix that and then finally after ignoring those errors with the overlapping rectangles I managed to finish the pcb in the pcb editor but by this time I was practically braindead because of how frustrating this was and had gpt summarize and simplify how to get the bom files and csv and stuff and then I uploaded and put it into jlcpcb. Oh between when I was fixing teh clearance errors and the jlcpcb I had ran into other errors such as the error with silkscreen being clipped and silkscreen clearance issues and footprint doesnt copy in the library and I found this exetremely annoying and couldn figure out how to fix it until the very end where chatgpt told me to straight up ignore it and it all ended well. My mental health is cooked. (Part 1 because I tried adding the 9 images but only 7 of them came through, the next entry will have the next 2 images).

Oh between when I was fixing teh clearance errors and the jlcpcb I had ran into other errors such as the error with silkscreen being clipped and silkscreen clearance issues and footprint doesnt copy in the library and I found this exetremely annoying and couldn figure out how to fix it until the very end where chatgpt told me to straight up ignore it and it all ended well. My mental health is cooked. (Part 1 because I tried adding the 9 images but only 7 of them came through, the next entry will have the next 2 images). this is part 2 I started at 9:50am  and grinded 9 hours straight working while eating my meals, this is the other 2 hours I finished around 7:00 7:20 ish.
